summary: Verified a realized policy-state change: OPEC+ officially held November 2026 required production for seven participating producers at September 2026 levels. This supersedes the prior expectation-only state. The result is research-context material because it removes a November target increase as a near-term policy relief channel, while realized supply and export normalization remain unverified.

evidence.observed_finding: Prior state contained an expectation that OPEC+ would keep November targets steady, not the completed decision.
OPEC states that the seven countries decided to maintain September 2026 required production for November 2026 and will meet again on 1 November 2026.
Reuters confirms the decision and reports realized Gulf production remained below targets amid export disruptions.

evidence.verification: Exact JSON content re-fetched from main and matched intended payload.

blockers: Exact OPEC+ meeting decision time was not published; event time uses the earliest accessed confirmed Reuters publication time.
No independently verified synchronized realized-production, export-throughput, inventory, refined-product crack, or cross-asset price-reaction dataset was available in this run.
